main_measure.name: slope of 10-bar forward return net of drift on -forecast (grid, forecast < 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t <= -2 (with supporting check); reject if slope t >= +2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move in the short direction (-(10-bar return - drift)) > 0

decided_by: the slope t lies between -2 and +2
reading: Situation = raw stretch_below < 0 with forecast < 0; grid = bars 0,10,20,... of each window with a full 10-bar forward return; drift = coin's mean 10-bar return on that grid over all its windows; pooled OLS across coins and windows with the ordinary slope t; fewer than 30 cases is reported as not observable.
